blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Over 20,000 teaching positions of the Department of Education (DepEd) are currently unfilled, according to Davao de Oro Rep. Maricar Zamora on Tuesday. During the House sponsorship and plenary deliberations on the proposed DepEd budget for next year, ACT Teachers Party-list Rep. Antonio Tinio asked Zamora about the current status of vacant teaching positions. Zamora, the agency’s budget sponsor, answered queries from other lawmakers. She said DepEd created more than 31,000 positions under the 2026 General Appropriations Act (GAA). She noted that of this figure, over 22,700 teaching positions were already filled.
